system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. For each number, decide from the rows the
Zetaris query returned whether the source of record supports it. Use only the rows shown, never outside knowledge.

- confirmed: the rows state the same number for the same quantity (same biomarker, dose, timepoint, arm or comparison).
- contradicts: the rows state a different value for the same quantity (for example the registry gives another number
  of patients, or the abstract gives another percent change for the same dose and timepoint).
- not_found: the rows do not mention the number or the quantity (an error or no rows is always not_found).

Return JSON only:
{"results": [{"claim": "c1", "status": "confirmed|not_found|contradicts",
              "found": "<the value or sentence from the rows, short>", "note": "<one short sentence>"}]}
prompt:
Case: HPS2-THRIVE NCT00461630 - Treatment of HDL to Reduce the Incidence of Vascular Events HPS2-THRIVE

Numbers (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | HDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = 19.6 % | {"biomarker": "other", "dose": "ERN/LRPT 2 g/40 mg/day", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "weeks 21 to 32", "trial": "HPS2-THRIVE NCT00461630"} | source pmid:22683042 | quote: "ERN/LRPT 19.6%"
c2 | HDL-C change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = 9.2 % | {"biomarker": "other", "dose": "placebo", "kind": "percent", "method": "not stated", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "weeks 21 to 32", "trial": "HPS2-THRIVE NCT00461630"} | source pmid:22683042 | quote: "placebo 9.2%"
c3 | follow-up | median_followup = 3.9 years | {"trial": "HPS2-THRIVE"} | source ctgov:NCT00461630@2012-12-20 | quote: "Major Vascular Event [During scheduled treatment period (median duration 3.9 years)]"

Query results (claim | SQL | rows):
c1 | SQL: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*19\.6%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '22683042' LIMIT 5 | rows: [["001; ERN/LRPT 19.6%; ERN 48"]]
c2 | SQL: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*9\.2%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '22683042' LIMIT 5 | rows: [["9%; placebo 9.2%)"]]
c3 | SQL: SELECT o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o WHERE o.measure LIKE '%Major Vascular Event%' LIMIT 5 | rows: [["During scheduled treatment period (median duration 3.9 years)"]]

Judge each number.
